## Description {#details}

<p>This pass should be invoked at the end of wwm-regalloc pipeline.</p>


<p>It identifies the WWM regs allocated during this pipeline and add them to the list of reserved registers so that they won't be available for per-thread VGPR allocation in the subsequent regalloc pipeline.</p>
